title: Per-µservice Multi-Region Disposition Canonical Spec
purpose: Declares the canonical per-µservice multi-region disposition enum, the sovereign-tenant region-pin overlay contract, the global control-plane shape, and the per-pack default topology matrix. Operationalizes ADR-0158.

active_active.description: Multiple write-able regions; data converges via CRDT (ADR-0142) or quorum-write or append-only-merge.

active_passive.description: One primary region; warm-standby region(s); failover RPO + RTO declared.

single_region.description: Pinned to one region; failover intra-region only.

sovereign_tenant_pin_overlay.description: Per-pack tenant residency overrides per-µservice disposition. A pack-ksa tenant in strict_ksa residency is pinned to KSA cell regardless of µservice disposition.
sovereign_tenant_pin_overlay.enforcement_point: api-gateway µservice (ADR-0157) rejects mismatched cells at edge with 421 Misdirected Request + Location header.

behaviors.active_active_with_sovereign_pin: Only the sovereign cell's replica handles the tenant.
behaviors.active_passive_with_sovereign_pin: Only the sovereign cell handles; failover intra-sovereign-region only.
behaviors.single_region_with_sovereign_pin_mismatc: µservice unavailable to the sovereign tenant; PRD must declare explicitly.

tenant_registry.location: microservices/tenancy/ — global table; replicated via Patroni cross-region async (~5s lag).
tenant_registry.dns_strategy: anycast pointing api-gateway tier at nearest replica

routing_decision.active_active: serves locally if allowed_regions includes current cell

global_control_plane.cross_region_database_transactions: forbidden; data plane is strictly regional; cross-region consistency is per-µservice (CRDT-merge / async-replication-warm-standby / none)

ci_lanes.purpose: every µservice declares disposition; matches actual deployment shape
api-gateway route table rejects mismatched cells
